Name: Translate every mod in your language - ModTRANS
Author: doccAS
Description:
[size=6][b]ModTrans - Universal Mod Translator[/b][/size]

Have you ever found an amazing Stardew Valley mod, only to realize it's not available in your native language?
[b]ModTrans[/b] is a powerful, standalone desktop tool that uses AI to automatically translate [i]any[/i] Stardew Valley mod into [i]any[/i] language in a matter of seconds.
Unlike traditional translators that only work with standard dictionary files, ModTrans features a surgical injection system. It safely scans and translates hardcoded text inside
[code]content.json[/code]and
[code]manifest.json[/code]files without breaking the mod's code or logic! Whether you want to translate a massive expansion from Chinese to English, or a dialogue mod from English to French, ModTrans handles the heavy lifting for you.
[line]

[b][size=5]Main Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Universal Language Support:[/b] Select your source and target languages from a simple dropdown menu. The AI automatically understands the context and provides native-sounding translations.[/*]
[*][b]Hardcoded Strings Support:[/b] Translates both standard
[code]i18n/default.json[/code]files AND hardcoded
[code]content.json[/code](Content Patcher) mods safely. It even translates the mod's description in the
[code]manifest.json[/code][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Standalone GUI[/size]:[/b] No coding knowledge, Python installation, or command lines required. Just double-click the
[code].exe[/code]and use the clean, user-friendly interface.[/*]
[*][b][size=4]Auto-Deploy[/size]:[/b] Once the translation is complete, the tool can automatically export the fully working mod directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. Ready to play![/*]
[*][b][size=4]Smart QA System[/size]:[/b] Features an optional "AI Judge" system. If enabled, two AI inspectors will review the translations for accuracy and code integrity, fixing errors automatically before saving.[/*]
[*][b][size=4]Manual Review Window[/size]:[/b] Review, edit, and approve translations manually through a built-in interface before applying them to the game[/*]
[/list][center][size=6][b]⚠️ Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
ModTrans is an external Windows application, so it doesn't require any specific Stardew Valley framework to run. However, to power the AI translation, you will need:
[list]
[*][b]An OpenRouter API Key:[/b] The tool connects to OpenRouter to access AI models (like Gemini, Claude, GPT or free-one). Generating a key is completely free, and many powerful models are virtually free or cost a few cents for hundreds of mods.[/*]
[*][b]Windows OS:[/b] The current release is compiled as a .exe for Windows.[/*]
[/list][center][size=5][b]🛠️ Installation Instructions & Setup[/b][/size][/center]
Setting up ModTrans takes less than two minutes:
[list=1]
[*][b][size=4]Download and Extract[/size]:[/b] 
Download theModTrans.zipfile from the Files tab and extract it into a folder on your PC.[/*]
[*][b][size=4]Get your API Key[/size]:[/b] Go to [url=https://openrouter.ai/]OpenRouter.ai[/url], create a free account, and generate an API key from your account settings. you can follow
Here's an easy tutorial on YouTube  (I'm not the author of the video) 
>>> https://youtu.be/ZELx_OzYAQo?si=CMPA_FSQdyzfhxd9[/*]
[*][b][size=4]Configure the Tool:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Open the
[code]config.toml[/code]file included in the ModTrans folder using Notepad or any text editor software.[/*]
[*]Look for the line
[code]api_key = "YOUR_API_HERE"[/code][/*]
[*]Replace the placeholder text (YOUR_API_HERE) with your actual API key. make sure to keep the quotation marks! 
[code]"sk-...[your API key]"[/code][/*]
[*]Choose a model on
[code]
model = ""[/code][/*]
[/list]the default one I chose is openai/gpt-6-luna, but you can choose anyone you prefer, by simply copying its name. 
N.B.  openai/gpt-6-luna is a great, cheap model but it's NOT free! This means that if you wanna use this tool for free, you have to change it to a free one!!!need help changing model? gotchu, here's a little easy tutorial :)

[/list][list=1]
Then save and close the file.4. Launch: Double-click.ModTrans.exe5. Translate: Select the folder of the mod you want to translate, choose your languages, select your Stardew Valley Mods folder, and hit Translate Mod![/list]

[center][size=5][b]Features & Tips[/b][/size]
[/center]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Auto-Unzip Integration[/size]:[/b] You don't even need to extract the mods you download! Just click the [b]"From ZIP..."[/b] button in the tool, select your downloaded archive, and ModTrans will automatically extract it and prepare it for translation.[/*]
[*][b][size=4]The "Two Judges" QA System[/size]:[/b] By default, ModTrans uses a fast, direct translation method. However, you can enable a rigorous Quality Assurance system by opening your
[code]config.toml[/code]and removing the
[code]#[/code]symbols in front of the
[code][judge_a][/code]and
[code][judge_b][/code]sections. 
This activates two AI inspectors that will double-check the translation for accuracy and formatting errors, automatically forcing a repair if game tags are broken. This feature is highly recommended for complex language pairs (e.g., translating from Chinese/Japanese to European languages).[/*]
[*][b][size=4]Safe Backup & Restore[/size]:[/b] Worried about messing up a mod?[b][u] Don't be[/u][/b]. 
ModTrans automatically creates a hidden backup of the original files before applying any translations. If you don't like the result, simply click the "Restore Backup" button in the interface to revert the mod to its original state instantly.[/*]
[/list][center][size=5][b]⚠️ Troubleshooting Common Errors[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
If you check the "Execution Log" in the tool and see a warning, here is what it means:
[list]
[*][code]Missing manifest.json/ Not a Stardew Mod[/code]You selected the wrong folder. Make sure you are selecting the exact folder that contains the manifest.json file inside it, not the outer download folder.[/*]
[*][code]BLOCK status / Strings left in English [/code]Sometimes, a line of text contains complex programming logic instead of just dialogue. If the AI feels that translating it might break your game, it will safely mark the string as 'BLOCK' and leave it in its original language. You can fix or approve these manually.[/*]
[*][code] API Authentication Error / Batch Failed [/code]The tool cannot connect to the AI. Double-check your [i]config.toml[/i] file to ensure your OpenRouter API key is pasted perfectly between the quotation marks, with no extra spaces.[/*]
[/list][center][b][size=5]Feedback & Bug Reports[/size][/b][/center]
[b]ModTrans is a brand-new release![/b]
While it has been tested, the Stardew Valley modding scene is huge, and some mods have very unique code structures. If you encounter any bugs, game crashes after a translation, or weird text formatting, [b]please let me know in the Posts/Comments section![/b]
If you get an error, please copy and paste the text from the "Execution Log" in your report. Your feedback is incredibly valuable and will help improve the tool for the whole community!
